description: This Java class, DeviceConnectionClientFactoryImpl, implements a factory pattern for creating and managing device connection clients in the Eclipse Hono framework. It manages client creation, caching, and handles tenant timeout events.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class that creates and manages device connection clients, handling cache and tenant timeout events within the Hono framework.

methods.name: DeviceConnectionClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a HonoConnection and sets up event bus consumer for tenant timeout.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup by clearing client cache when disconnect occurs.

methods.name: getOrCreateDeviceConnectionClient
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves or creates a device connection client for a specified tenant ID.

methods.name: removeDeviceConnectionClient
methods.description: Removes a specific device connection client from the cache.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages, closing and removing associated clients.
